full_judgment: 28. The prosecution case against accused Ibrahim Hossain Sarker is that, he processed the two cheques Exts 4 and 6 for Taka 1,71,800.00 facilitating the withdrawal of the money from current deposit account No. 2400. Expert's opinion Ext 29 proves that the writings of two cheques are in the hand of accused Ibrahim Hossain Sarker. Besides that he also prepared the OBCS and entered the same in the relevant register and made ways for carrying them by hand although they are scheduled to be sent by registered post particularly when account holder Salimuddin was obviously not known to him. So, by allowing unwanted latitude he not only made himself liable for negligence of duty but played a definite part in the illegal bargain. It is found from the record that current deposit account No. 9956 was opened on 22-10-79 at Janata Bank, Main Branch, Motijheel. Dhaka in the name of one Kamrul Huda who was introduced by NazemAli Bari, holder of current deposit account No. 9621, against which cheque book was issued. Accused Jahangir Hossain and Yasin Miah verified the disputed cheques whereas Jahangir Hossain verified the signature of Nowab Ali Bai. The handwriting expert's report Ext 29 proves the signature of Nawab Ali Bari as given in the account opening form of current deposit account No. 9965 does not tally with the specimen signatures. In spite of all these, accused Ibrahim Hossain Sarker verified and authenticated the signatures while accused Yasin Main falsely authenticated the specimen signatures of Kamrul Huda. This Kamrul Huda has also been proved to be a fictitious person in whose name current deposit account No. 9956 was opened with oblique motives. This current deposit account No. 9956 was opened with Taka 500.00 only, following which a cheque book was issued in his name for facilitating planned defalcations.
